stem:
Javed places the fraction 3/4 on a number line marked from 0 to 1.

Which plan places 3/4 correctly?

options.text: Divide the interval from 0 to 1 into 4 equal lengths and count 3 of those lengths from 0.
Mark a point near 1 because the printed 4 looks large, without making equal lengths.
Place 3/4 by comparing only how large 3 looks next to 4 on the page.
The number-line placement rule also requires changing 3/4 into another kind of number first.

teacher.key_rationale: To place a/b on [0,1], partition into b equal parts and count a parts from 0. Choosing by how large a printed digit looks is surface capture. Requiring a change into another kind of number first is outside this placement rule.

mx_swap.reason: A missing-unit-interval omission is awkward as a parallel claim once the stem already marks 0 to 1; kept surface_feature_capture and scope_error.
Unit-fraction denominator-size CWO invents a different hinge and nouns; kept surface_feature_capture and scope_error on partition-and-count.
